natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%; renewals weak.

first.rationale: The immediate declines in onboarding completion and activation align directly with prior evidence that shorter, lower-friction onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and durable SMB activation. I will verify both underlying records before committing, while avoiding broad price discounting because prior evidence indicates weaker retention despite near-term revenue gains.
